sources: Export names enumerated at runtime from the published packages (scripts/enumerate-exports.mjs).
Type exports and notes from the API reference at remotion.dev/docs.
excluded: Names ending in `Internals` and CommonJS interop keys are not public API and are not listed.

elevenLabsTranscriptToCaptions.note: Equal to the oracle over 555 inputs (captions with key order, failing inputs, class, field named); never calls the API (D-062).

Gif.note: Decoded frames, frame timing and canvas pixels equal Remotion's; stills identical with swangle. effects throws (D-053).

getGifDurationInSeconds.note: Equal to the oracle, content-type check and broken files included (D-053).

preloadGif.note: Shares one decode with <Gif>; waitUntilDone and free as the oracle (D-053).

convertToCaptions.note: Deprecated, reference page gone: throws, pointing to toCaptions() (D-062).

downloadWhisperModel.note: Same Hugging Face URL and file name as recorded; downloads to a temporary name first (D-062).

installWhisperCpp.note: Same git and make commands as recorded; Windows (where Remotion downloads a binary) throws (D-062).

toCaptions.note: Equal to the oracle over 83 outputs, a real jfk.wav transcription included (D-062).

transcribe.note: Same whisper.cpp arguments as recorded for 13 option sets and the same JSON end to end (1.5.5, tiny.en); the WAVE sample rate is checked before running; output goes to a temporary folder, not the working directory (D-062).

lightLeak.note: An effect for the effects prop of canvas components, which Motio does not have: throws, pointing to <LightLeak> (D-057).

LightLeak.note: Props, markup, timing and errors equal the published package; Motio draws its own pattern, since Remotion's shader is not documented: the pixels differ (D-056).

lightLeakEffectSchema.note: Plain data, equal to the recorded value (D-056).

Lottie.note: Frame mapping equal to the oracle; SVG stills identical (D-052).

getLottieMetadata.note: Equal to the oracle over 477 inputs (D-052).

AudioForPreview.note: No docs page: rendering it throws a message pointing to <Audio> (D-045).

getTargetSampleRate.note: No docs page: returns 48000, the value recorded from the published package in Node and Chrome (D-045).

CameraMotionBlur.note: Markup and rendered stills equal Remotion's (D-048).

HtmlInCanvasMotionBlur.note: Markup, sample times and rendered stills match Remotion's within the M1 thresholds, the documented example identical; media frame reuse is not reproduced (D-059).

Trail.note: Markup and rendered stills equal Remotion's (D-048).

isOpenAiWhisperTranscript.note: Equal to the oracle over 407 inputs (D-062).

openAiWhisperApiToCaptions.note: Equal to the oracle over 1,044 inputs, punctuation matching and segment fallback included; never calls the API (D-062).

extractAudio.note: Copies the first audio stream with FFmpeg; decoded samples equal the oracle's for AAC, MP3, PCM and Opus in WebM. Also writes .m4a, which Remotion 4.0.545 rejects; Opus into .opus keeps FFmpeg's Ogg pre-skip (96024 samples, Remotion 96648).

getSilentParts.note: FFmpeg's silencedetect; equal to the oracle except the MP3 duration (container duration, Remotion adds the encoder padding) and a 0.5 ms start on Opus. Works on PCM WAV files, which Remotion 4.0.545 fails on.

getVideoMetadata.note: Through ffprobe; equal to the oracle on every Remotion field for H.264 (MP4, MKV), H.265, VP9 and ProRes files. Motio adds rotation. Local files only, as documented.

stitchFramesToVideo.note: videoBitrate, bufferSize, maxRate, gopSize, metadata, ffmpegOverride and hardware acceleration fail with E_INVALID_OPTION, as in renderMedia (D-045).

RemotionRiveCanvas.note: Same runtime version; canvas pixels, markup, times and failures equal the oracle; stills identical with swangle. Seeks from the start, so out-of-order frames do not depend on the previous one; effects throws (D-061).

RiveCanvasRef.note: The four getters return the runtime's animation instance, artboard, renderer and runtime (D-061).

SkiaCanvas.note: Not implemented: @motiojs/skia does not exist yet, so the compat plugin fails the build with a message pointing to D-063.

starburst.note: An effect for the effects prop of canvas components, which Motio does not have: throws, pointing to <Starburst> (D-057).

Starburst.note: Stills equal to Remotion's with swangle; fractional ray counts turned past the left seam color their rays differently (D-055).

starburstEffectSchema.note: Plain data, equal to the recorded value (D-055).
